title: ReviewFindings
description: The review agent's whole answer: its findings, each citing a rule of the slice, a file and a line, and each blocking one the new witness test that confirms it. Each finding's fields are the engine's machine.Finding.

rule.description: The slice rule the finding concerns, `R-<n>`, as tagged in features/slice.feature.

file.description: The project file, relative to the project folder, for example internal/notes/notes.go.

line.description: The line in that file, counted from 1: a statement the witness test runs, not a func, blank or comment line.

text.description: What is wrong and why, in one or two sentences.

blocking.description: True only when the code breaks the rule and the finding's new witness test fails having run this line; otherwise false (a suggestion).

witness.description: The new witness test this review wrote for the finding: a Go test file in the rule's folder review/r<n>/ (rule R-<n>) and the test function in it. Required when blocking is true.

file.description: The witness file, relative to the project folder, for example review/r1/list_test.go.

test.description: The test function's name: TestR<n> for the finding's rule R-<n>, then a name not starting with a digit, for example TestR1ListKeepsEveryNote.
